claim: Agentgateway's standalone request scheduler mode does not support the Kubernetes InferencePool resource.
stance_target: which gateways only work with Kubernetes InferencePool
scope_conditions: agentgateway standalone deployment mode, current docs
quoted_support: Standalone request scheduler mode does not support InferencePool.

claim: In agentgateway standalone mode, setting destinationMode: passthrough tells agentgateway to forward EPP-selected destinations directly rather than validating them against locally known workload endpoints.
stance_target: how the proxy honors the EPP's chosen destination when backends are not pods
quoted_support: When EPP owns endpoint discovery, set destinationMode: passthrough so EPP-selected destinations can be forwarded to directly without matching local workload endpoint data.

claim: Agentgateway standalone mode requires a synthetic top-level 'services' entry that the route backend references, since there is no real service discovery backing the route.
stance_target: how non-k8s backends are configured in agentgateway
quoted_support: The standalone configuration must define a top-level synthetic service, such as a services entry, and the route backend must reference that service.

claim: The upstream llm-d-router standalone Helm chart can deploy agentgateway as the sidecar proxy using proxyType: agentgateway.
stance_target: llm-d packaging of alternative router proxies
quoted_support: the upstream standalone Helm chart can deploy agentgateway as the sidecar proxy with proxyType: agentgateway.
